comment.body:
Made a fork of the nspawn plugin since that is tonic already for reproduction: https://codeberg.org/mafrw/runner-systemd-nspawn
Added to the runner config:
```yaml
plugins:
  systemd-nspawn:
    address: unix:///tmp/nspawn-plugin.sock
```
Downloaded the latest runner binary release, connected it to the forgejo test instance and created a workflow that depends on that backend
```yaml
name: helloworld

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:

jobs:
  hello:
    name: hello
    runs-on: nspawn-fedora-44
    steps:
      - run: echo Hello World!
```
Gives us the error mentioned above
```
Runner e6730f12-c52a-478d-9cf4-f962a5d2a4a3 (version:v13.2.0) received task 2651 of job hello, triggered by event: workflow_dispatch
workflow prepared
🔌 Connecting to plugin systemd-nspawn at unix:///tmp/nspawn-plugin.sock
plugin systemd-nspawn: health check plugin at passthrough:////tmp/nspawn-plugin.sock: rpc error: code = Internal desc = stream terminated by RST_STREAM with error code: PROTOCOL_ERROR
```

Hi @mfenniak. Thank you for your work on the plugin architecture. I test and use it actively with your [runner-systemd-nspawn](https://codeberg.org/mfenniak/runner-systemd-nspawn) plugin and have created a few feature requests specific to that plugin there:

1. [Use machines of any type (raw images, directories, etc.)](https://codeberg.org/mfenniak/runner-systemd-nspawn/issues/61)
2. [User namespacing, --private-users=pick or --private-users=managed](https://codeberg.org/mfenniak/runner-systemd-nspawn/issues/71)
3. [Consider using --notify-ready=true and avoid checking multi-user.target and network-online.target](https://codeberg.org/mfenniak/runner-systemd-nspawn/issues/72)
4. [Consider allowing container: options: to pass through to faciliate testing of options](https://codeberg.org/mfenniak/runner-systemd-nspawn/issues/78)

I agree with @roman-eidenai about the current options/defaults being targeted toward docker.

comment.body:
@Cysioland wrote in https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/issues/1777#issue-14934:

> I cannot reproduce on next because of there being no runner (unless I'm doing something wrong).

You should be able to attach a runner yourself. But it's rarely necessary.

> The issue is that before validation of workflows has been introduced (so, a long time ago), I was able to select which matrix steps to run through `workflow_dispatch` parameters, now it's impossible.

The problem is the usage of `matrix` in `if:`. `matrix` is not [available there](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/user/actions/reference/#availability). GitHub [agrees](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/contexts#context-availability). It's unlikely that we'll add `matrix` there because it will cause precedence problems.

I don't have an idea for a workaround right now.
